questions.label: Who took the wages bag?

possibilities.quote: Mr. Wicks is the foreman, living at Garth's Mill
Job Tarrant is the carter, living at Garth's Mill

questions.answer_given_quote: Job Tarrant said to the constable: "It was I who took the wages bag from the counting-room."

questions.label: Where was Mr. Wicks at half past eight on Friday evening?

possibilities.quote: Mr. Wicks was in my kitchen

questions.quote: Where was Mr. Wicks at half past eight on Friday evening?
questions.answer_given_quote: Job Tarrant said to the constable: "At half past eight on Friday evening, Mr. Wicks was in Mrs. Dabney's kitchen."
